target.statement: Average correct classification (CC) rate of Boundary Peeling (BP) on unimodal and bimodal simulated data with no outliers (n=50, d=100), reported as 97.928 in Table 1.
target.dataset: Synthetic data generated as described in Section 3 (multivariate normal, t, lognormal, Wishart; unimodal and bimodal; correlations 0, 0.5, 0.75; no outliers)

compute.basis: No code for BP/EBP is provided; the agent must implement the peeling algorithm from the paper and run 1000 simulations per scenario (24 scenarios in Table 1) with OCSVM, which is CPU-bound and may take a few hours on 8 cores.

blockers: No official implementation of Boundary Peeling or Ensembled Boundary Peeling is linked; only PyOD is referenced for baselines.
The exact simulation code and random seeds are not provided, so reproducing the exact average may require re-implementing the data generation and peeling procedure.
title: Boundary Peeling: Outlier Detection Method Using One-Class Peeling
